recommended_deployment.name: GitHub Actions scheduler with managed private storage
recommended_deployment.description: Python scheduled workflow runs source-specific collectors; raw payloads go to private S3-compatible object storage and normalized records to managed PostgreSQL. Environment-scoped credentials are injected at runtime and never written to logs or Git.

fallback_deployment.name: Private host scheduler with local encrypted storage
fallback_deployment.description: A private always-on Python host uses cron/launchd, ignored local raw snapshots and PostgreSQL/SQLite for research continuity; it is less reliable and is not a public production architecture.
